article.story: Atlanta Hawks vs. Orlando Magic Orlando, Florida; Wednesday, 7 p.m. EDT LINE: Magic -2.5; over/under is 234.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Orlando Magic open the season at home against the Atlanta Hawks. Orlando went 45-37 overall, 9-8 in Southeast Division action and 26-16 at home last season. The Magic averaged 115.7 points per game while allowing opponents to score 115.1 last season. Atlanta finished 46-36 overall, 9-7 in Southeast Division action and 22-19 on the road last season. The Hawks allowed opponents to score 116.0 points per game and shoot 47.4% from the field last season. INJURIES: Magic: Noah Penda: out (hamstring), Jase Richardson: day to day (back), Franz Wagner: day to day (shoulder). Hawks: Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
